units.source_text: 现在我正面对波涛，迎着狂暴的北风。

en.t: Now I face the waves, meeting the violent north wind head on.

units.source_text: 这里没有晴朗的春天的下午，也没有担心修剪过的草坪，

en.t: Here there is no clear spring afternoon, nor any carefully trimmed lawn to worry over,

units.source_text: 可是这荒凉的自然，比春天午后的草坪更讨我的欢心，更亲近我的存在。

en.t: yet this desolate nature pleases me more than a lawn on a spring afternoon, and lies closer to my own existence.
Here, my heart is fully satisfied.

units.source_text: 我可以不受任何威胁了。

en.t: I can be free from every threat now.
